prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity landscape desktop website first-viewport comp, 1536×1024
Primary request: Design one unmistakably usable public portfolio homepage for a developer focused on financial tools. The visual direction is SECURITY PRINTER’S PROOF, inspired by banknote engraver progressive proof sheets, but it must remain a contemporary portfolio interface rather than a poster.
Scene/backdrop: full desktop webpage canvas on cool cotton bond, with decisive whole-frame section transitions implied below the fold.
Subject and layout: A thin navigation registration strip spans the top. Place the dominant thesis on the left. Place “GitHub activity” on the right as a living proof lattice: an intricate but practical contribution-grid interface fused with engraved linework, registration crosses, subtle provenance marks, and a guilloché field. Let this lattice/engraved field be the single focal move. At the bottom of the visible viewport, begin a clearly separated numbered lower band for “Financial app project” so enough of the second fold is visible to establish scroll continuity. Keep all other areas quiet, spacious, and highly legible.
Style/medium: shippable high-fidelity web UI mockup, editorial portfolio, precise responsive grid, modern accessible typography, fine intaglio linework, security-print proof-sheet craft, contemporary interface controls. Hierarchy should come through depth, ink density, and brightness before boxes. Continuous provenance should visually carry across sections, and history should feel accumulated in layered proof marks.
Color palette: cool cotton #E9EEF2, deep navy #0C2D48, oxidized teal #008C7A, safety vermilion #FF5A36, ink #101820.
Materials/textures: cool cotton bond, restrained paper grain, fine intaglio engraving, registration marks, guilloché fields.
Text (verbatim, render exactly and only these words; no additional prose or labels): “HOME”, “PROJECTS”, “ABOUT”, “RESUME”, “CONTACTS”, “BLOG”, “Developer focused on financial tools.”, “I build and write about technology, development, and finance.”, “Explore my work”, “GitHub activity”, “Financial app project”.
Typography and placement: uppercase compact navigation across the top strip; large confident sentence-case hero headline on the left; supporting line directly below; “Explore my work” as a clear accessible action; “GitHub activity” labels the right proof lattice; “Financial app project” labels the lower band. All text must be crisp, correctly spelled, and immediately readable.
Interaction cues: The activity lattice may suggest kinetic emphasis only through a few brighter cells where data would change; do not show fabricated counts, dates, streaks, or metrics.
Constraints: exact 3:2 landscape desktop viewport feel; polished enough to implement; practical navigation and CTA; visible page edges only, no laptop or browser chrome; no invented metrics, company names, clients, testimonials, app names, employers, claims, logos, watermarks, extra headlines, or extra body copy.
Avoid: bank website, fintech product landing page, cryptocurrency aesthetic, literal currency note, cash imagery, coins, dollar signs, trading charts, neon cyberpunk, poster composition, atmospheric illustration, excessive boxes, generic dashboard cards, tiny illegible typography.
